categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Astro static site with clean HTML, minimal JS
Proper canonical URLs on all pages
Sitemap via @astrojs/sitemap
robots.txt allows all crawlers including AI bots

findings.title: Redirect pages use meta refresh instead of HTTP 301
findings.description: All 17 redirect paths use <meta http-equiv=refresh> with noindex. Meta refresh passes minimal link equity. Static hosts support proper 301 redirect configs.
findings.recommendation: Use hosting platform redirect config (_redirects file or equivalent) instead of Astro HTML meta-refresh pages.

findings.title: No explicit favicon link in <head>
findings.description: Relies on /favicon.ico at root. Explicit <link rel=icon> ensures all crawlers and platforms pick it up.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel=icon type=image/svg+xml href=/favicon.svg> and a .ico fallback link to Layout.astro.

findings.title: CSS is render-blocking
findings.description: Leaflet CSS (~76 KB from unpkg CDN) and Tailwind CSS (42 KB) loaded synchronously in <head>. Delays LCP and FCP.
findings.recommendation: Use media=print onload trick for non-critical CSS; self-host Leaflet CSS.

findings.title: GA4 uses placeholder ID G-XXXXXXXXXX
findings.description: All pages include the Google Analytics snippet with a dummy ID, adding ~1 KB inline JS and an extra network request.
findings.recommendation: Replace with real GA4 measurement ID or remove both script blocks.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Deep, original content on all 10 beach detail pages
Well-structured sections: Transport, Food, Stay, Clothing, Safety, Tips
Chinese names included for practical use
International visitor section with payment, visa, etiquette info

findings.title: Broken Best Time to Visit section on all 10 beach pages
findings.description: Template outputs ' offers ideal conditions for . ' — no beach name, no content. Broken template literal in BeachLayout.astro.
findings.recommendation: Fix the template literal to include beach name and best season data.

findings.title: Photo Spots section duplicated on all 10 beach pages
findings.description: Template has duplicate conditional blocks rendering the same section twice, causing duplicate content ID issues.
findings.recommendation: Remove the first incomplete conditional block in BeachLayout.astro.

findings.title: Duplicate H1 on homepage
findings.description: Two <h1> tags: Hero (Shenzhen Beach Guide) and CheatSheet (Shenzhen Beach Cheat Sheet). The CheatSheet should be H2.

findings.title: llms.txt incomplete
findings.description: Only lists 3 of 10 beaches. Reduces AI discoverability for 70% of content.
findings.recommendation: Add all 10 beach detail pages with descriptions.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Clean keyword-rich <title> tags
Descriptive meta descriptions on all pages
Proper heading hierarchy on detail pages
Breadcrumb navigation with aria-label

findings.title: OG images missing on all beach detail pages
findings.description: BeachLayout accepts ogImage prop but beach page files never pass it. Each beach has a dedicated WebP image that could be used.
findings.recommendation: Pass ogImage prop from each src/pages/beaches/*.astro to BeachLayout.

findings.title: Nav uses hash links on non-homepage pages
findings.description: Nav links like /#compare work incorrectly on beach detail pages — they jump to homepage first.
findings.recommendation: Use conditional logic: on homepage use #section, on other pages use /#section.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: TouristDestination, TouristAttraction, ImageObject, FAQPage schemas
GeoCoordinates, PostalAddress, AggregateRating
Chinese alternateName in all beach schemas
Proper @graph wrapping for multi-schema pages

findings.title: FAQ structured data uses raw bus numbers as answers
findings.description: How do I get to Dameisha Beach? answer is '103, 387, M191, M362, M438, M465' — raw bus numbers with no context. Not helpful for Voice Search.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite FAQ answer generation to produce full natural-language sentences.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: WebP format for all served images
width/height attributes on all img tags (CLS prevention)
loading=lazy on below-fold images
fetchpriority=high on hero image

findings.title: Render-blocking CSS delays LCP
findings.description: Combined ~120 KB of CSS (Leaflet + Tailwind + Google Fonts) loaded synchronously in head. No font-display strategy.
findings.recommendation: Add font-display:swap to Google Fonts URL. Defer non-critical CSS with media=print onload trick.

findings.title: No responsive images (srcset)
findings.description: All images serve a single resolution. Mobile users download desktop-sized images.
findings.recommendation: Use <picture> with srcset for smaller WebP variants on mobile.

findings.title: Unused JPGs in dist/images wasting space
findings.description: ~25 MB of .jpg files (2-3 MB each) exist in dist but are never referenced in HTML.
findings.recommendation: Remove JPGs from public/images or add build cleanup step.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt present at root
robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot
Good content depth with factual, citation-worthy claims
JSON-LD structured data makes content machine-readable

findings.title: llms.txt lists only 3 of 10 beaches
findings.description: Missing 7 beach detail pages reduces AI training data visibility for 70% of content.
findings.recommendation: Add all 10 beach detail pages with descriptions to llms.txt.

findings.title: No citation-friendly anchor IDs on facts
findings.description: Individual facts/claims lack id attributes. Adding them improves passage-level citability.
findings.recommendation: Add id attributes to key data points for AI citation readiness.

categories.name: Images
what_works: All images have alt text with both EN and CN names
WebP format throughout
loading=lazy on below-fold images
width and height attributes prevent CLS

findings.title: No responsive images (srcset)
findings.description: Single resolution for all viewports. Mobile users download unnecessarily large images.
findings.recommendation: Implement <picture> with srcset for 400w, 800w, and full variants.

findings.title: No image sitemap entries
findings.description: Google Image Search cannot easily discover beach photos without image sitemap entries.
